Maya: small docs PR to unify error-ref examples for 429/timeouts/context trim: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8591. need quick review of phrasing and snippets.
Owen: looks useful. which SDK snippets are included?
Maya: JS retry + python context-trim heuristic + a short curl example for non-idempotent guidance.
Ravi: runtime note: prefer recommending Retry-After if present, otherwise exp backoff+jitter. also call out idempotency caveat for generate vs chat.
Lena: nit: please add header names (Retry-After, X-RateLimit-Remaining) and a one-line ops flow for fallback routing.
Maya: adding headers and a one-liner flow. also will add one-line warning about aggressive cache TTL.
Owen: linter will want codeblocks tagged; ensure triple backticks + language.
Maya: fixed. DocsBot: PR 8591 updated ":compact error-ref". CI: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/8591/checks.
Lena: LGTM from docs side if snippets formatted.
Ravi: LGTM from runtime after header note.
Maya: thanks all, will merge tomorrow if no objections.
